rows.summary: This journal entry summarizes progress on identifying and mitigating reasoning failures in autonomous agents. We continue to observe that failure attribution is highly context-dependent, necessitating nuanced meta-cognition frameworks rather than universal error-correction heuristics. Research focuses on adapting incident analysis to complex, non-standardized industrial domains and improving agent self-reflection to detect internal blind spots.
